description: Implement the ability for users to share saved views with other users in the system. This feature should allow saved views to have configurable visibility and permissions, similar to how other objects in the system are shared. Additionally, migrate existing saved view dashboard/sidebar settings from the saved view model to user-specific UI settings.
functional_requirements: Add sharing functionality to saved views with configurable permissions (e.g., view, edit) for other users.
Migrate existing 'show_on_dashboard' and 'show_in_sidebar' settings from saved view model to user-specific UI settings, removing these fields from the saved view model.
Update the API to support saved view sharing operations and bump the API version accordingly.
Provide UI components for managing saved view permissions, similar to existing permission dialogs for other objects.
Ensure saved views appear correctly in dashboard and sidebar based on individual user's UI settings after migration.
